notes: Health axis delivered: LockoutTracker::health (crates/susi-gawd-swarm/src/cloud_lockout.rs) reports every dispatch scope as a typed susi_core::model_health::ModelHealth — Healthy on proven success, Unhealthy{RateLimited} while cooling (the deadline honours Retry-After, reason carries the ms timestamp), Degraded after timeouts/5xx while intermittent, Unhealthy{ServiceError} once repeated transient failure trips the circuit, Dead{InvalidCredential|Unsupported} for key-dead scopes, Dead{InsufficientQuota} for unfunded accounts, Unhealthy{InsufficientQuota} for out-of-quota until the reset. Failure classes are recorded on the entry (permanent_kind, last_kind — serde-defaulted so pre-existing persisted files load), so health() classifies correctly even with an Unknown caller verdict. Production wiring: parallel_dispatch::run_jobs reports JobOutcome::target_health — every consulted target's typed health next to the attempt trace; a 429'd candidate surfaces as Unhealthy{RateLimited}, the winner as Healthy (9 production call sites). State survives restart via the existing save/load JSON round-trip (mastery test). Axis separation is structural and refutation-tested: a storm of 429s+timeouts moves ModelHealth but leaves BrainRankStore score/confidence/evidence_n byte-identical — availability gates leadership only through rank's is_working predicate, never the score; a genuine wrong answer cannot mark unavailability because BrainRankStore consumes only HeldOut/VerifiedOutcome evidence and has no path back into lockout state.
